set.body:
Implement the missing compatibility of guest eligibility with the independent witness and closed restore. O04.3 owns the integrated withdrawal rehearsal and Q03.1 the physical-site evidence.

Acceptance criteria

1. Persist and replay supported guest sponsorship changes with verified attribution, expiry and current eligibility. Document capability negotiation and fail closed on unsupported journal versions or malformed evidence.
2. Restore a pre-change backup after a guest sponsorship ends and a release is withdrawn. Verify a continuing permitted reader can retrieve exact retained bytes while ended access and the withdrawn release remain unavailable.
3. Interrupt verification and replay, then retry without reopening on partial evidence. Compare permitted catalog history and current-access outcomes with the independent oracle.
4. Demonstrate compatible restoration or an explicit documented refusal for historical local-only eligibility/capability formats.

Verification

Synthetic local backup/witness rehearsal including guest, withdrawal, retained content, interrupted replay and historical recovery fixtures.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: OPS03: Recover sponsored guest eligibility alongside lifecycle restrictions
